title: Briefportal Leibniz: Ausgewählte Briefe
author: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz and correspondents
institution: Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen with the Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Bibliothek Hannover (Leibniz-Archiv)
region: Germany (Hanover) and the Low Countries, Switzerland
notes: Selected letters from the Akademie edition of Leibniz's correspondence (series III, volumes 5-8): 188 letters in the database, mostly the exchange with Johann Bernoulli, 1692-1701, with variant readings and graphics. Counts are ours, from the portal's search index: 148 letters dated 1692-1700 with about 180,000 words of edited text (maths markup and variants left out); 28 letters date from 1701 and 12 are undated. The metadata can be downloaded as TEI (adw_goettingen_leibniz_briefportal.xml, CC BY 4.0), but that file holds no letter text; the letters themselves are read in the portal.
